summary: End-to-end testing of the redesigned P&L Analyzer page. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass on /api/pl/analyzer/{kpis,trend,accounts,export} and /api/pl/sku-analysis-tree. Frontend: page renders correctly with header 'P&L Analyzer', all 6 KPI cards, Account Performance table, filter bar (search / category / color / RR min-max / Reset), export & refresh buttons, product tree (Sofia, Vertis with expandable colors). Export Summary button triggers /pl/analyzer/export returning 200 with xlsx content-type. Refresh button re-fetches KPIs (200). Auth guard confirmed (401 without Bearer). Preview Mongo has 0 orders, so KPIs show 0 and trend is empty — expected per agent note.

issues: When trend data is empty, the empty-state placeholder ('No profit trend data in this window') is rendered instead of the panel with data-testid="ana-trend". Automated tests keying on that testid will not find the panel in empty state. Consider adding data-testid="ana-trend" to the empty-state wrapper as well so the test id is stable across states.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="ana-trend" to the empty-state placeholder in PLSKUAnalysis.js (line ~576) so the selector is stable in zero-data preview environments.

No functional bugs — page & endpoints verified. Recommend re-testing with a Mongo instance that has real pl_orders seed data to confirm the drawer flow (SKU rows -> drawer -> 8 stat tiles -> last 20 orders table) end-to-end. In current preview, 0 orders means 0 SKU rows render, so drawer click path was not exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: PLSKUAnalysis.js is 612 lines with multiple sub-components (KPICard, TrendChart, AccountPerformanceTable, CategoryNode/ColorNode/AccountNode/SkuTable, SkuDrawer). Consider splitting into /components/pl/analyzer/*.jsx modules for maintainability (soft 700-line ceiling).
Trend empty-state placeholder lacks data-testid — inconsistent testability across states.
server.py pl_analyzer_export re-invokes 3 route handler functions directly. Works, but coupling is high; extracting shared aggregation logic into helpers would ease future changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% observable checks passed (drawer flow not exercisable with 0 orders)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing 2 accounts / 5 products / 0 orders as-is per agent instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_pl_analyzer.py — reuse for regression on analyzer endpoints. All 6 tests pass in ~1.8s. Login uses admin@meesho-dash.local / admin123. Preview Mongo (localhost) has minimal data (0 orders); to test SkuDrawer, seed pl_orders collection with delivered/returned docs matching an existing account_id + sku, then click any [data-testid^="ana-sku-"] row.
